chunks: “Indeed, one dirham in hajj is better than two million dirhams in what is other than it in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more excellent and superior in virtue
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: a unit of money; a dirham spent for devotion
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an honorific for Allah
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: in the way of Allah; for His cause

ai.seo_question: Why is spending on hajj considered more virtuous than other spending in the way of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense virtue of spending wealth in hajj. It teaches that expenditure for hajj holds a uniquely elevated rank, surpassing even vast spending in other acts done in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "A dirham spent on Hajj is better than two million dirhams spent elsewhere in the way of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic."
